reference_device: iPhone14,7 / iOS 17.3.1, portrait 390 x 844 points, ios-mcp
scope: Four selected iOS 17 portrait arithmetic flows. Basic addition derives from the reviewed Calculator report; decimal, negative and percent are added from current-device UI observations only.

flows.entry: Fresh-launch Calculator on the named iPhone 14 and enter 7 + 8 = after clearing.
actions: observe all clear, 7, 8, add and equals
capture stable screenshot and UIKit view tree
expected: Calculator remains frontmost during saved observations.
The final upper result UILabel contains exactly 15.
The final portrait screen retains the basic keypad and equals control.
flows.failure_state: Fail if a labelled control is missing, the foreground Bundle ID changes, the upper result is not exactly 15, or the keypad is absent.
flows.boundary: Other arithmetic, repeated equals, intermediate display values, saved history, scientific mode and locale formatting are not covered.
flows.verification: Replay the pinned original playbook and the same actions against a signed clone on this device. Assert foreground ownership, exact final UIKit result 15 and keypad presence; inspect paired screenshots for layout differences.
